name: LinkPurchaseOrderToSalesOrder
description:
Link a purchase order to the sales order it fulfils by placing both orders in the same order group.

Because `ListRelatedOrders` returns every order in the group, each order then appears in the other's related orders. The purchase order moves into the sales order's group; the sales order keeps its group and its other members. Linking a purchase order that is already linked to this sales order changes nothing; linking it to another sales order moves it there. Only the order group changes: fulfilment status, order lines, amounts and stock are untouched.

Only manually created purchase orders can be linked. A purchase order whose lines link to a sales order line through `RelatedOrderLineID` was created by order orchestration and already belongs to that sales order; moving it would make the order group disagree with its lines, so it is rejected.
auth_description: Requires a user of type `Employee` or `Api` with functionality `PurchaseOrders:Manage`

B.name: PurchaseOrderID
B.description:
The manually created purchase order that joins the sales order's group. When it is already linked to another sales order, it moves out of that group. A purchase order whose lines link to a sales order line is created by order orchestration and is rejected.

This is the ID of a `Order`

B.name: SalesOrderID
B.description:
The sales order whose group the purchase order joins; the sales order keeps its group and its other related orders.

This is the ID of a `Order`
